self.text: Hi there! I'm Parker, a Japanese non-binary person in my late 20s. I studied engineering in college, though these days I spend my free time knitting because I love the cozy, creative process. I'm currently looking for some language practice, and I think it would be great to find someone to study independently side by side. My ideal setup involves complete silence while working, but I would like someone to explain things to me. I am open to meeting either in person or online, depending on what works best. In terms of my schedule, I am available on Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon. I'm looking forward to finding a good rhythm and making some progress together!
